item.title: DeepChopper: A Genomic Language Model that Cleans Up Nanopore Direct RNA Sequencing
item.description:
The chimera mystery
#

Direct RNA sequencing (dRNA-seq) on Oxford Nanopore Technologies (ONT) platforms looks, on paper, like a transcriptomics dream. You sequence native RNA molecules end to end, you keep the modifications, and you skip every reverse-transcription and PCR step that has been quietly polluting short-read data for years. For a while, that was the story we were telling ourselves.

item.title: ChimeraLM: Structural Variant Detection in WGA Long-Read Sequencing
item.description: ChimeraLM is a language model for accurate structural variant detection in whole-genome amplified (WGA) long-read sequencing data. It is described in the paper A Language Model Enables Accurate Structural Variant Detection in Whole-Genome Amplified Long-Read Sequencing.

item.title: DeepChopper: Removing Chimeras in Nanopore Direct RNA Sequencing
item.description: DeepChopper is a genomic language model built on HyenaDNA that identifies and removes adapter-bridged chimera artifacts in nanopore direct RNA sequencing data. It is described in the paper Genomic Language Model Mitigates Chimera Artifacts in Nanopore Direct RNA Sequencing.

item.title: CUDA for Deep Learning Inference in Rust and C++
item.description:
1. Deep learning inference
#

Python still dominates model training, but both Rust and C++ are becoming serious options for inference, where Python’s overhead starts to hurt. Large language models (LLMs) such as ChatGPT have multiplied since their debut, and companies and research groups keep releasing new ones, though not all of them are equally useful.

item.title: Face Recognition in Video
item.description: The goal of this small project is to detect when a specific person appears in a video and record the corresponding timestamps. This post documents the environment, the material, the pipeline, and what I would improve.
